# Copyright (c) 2026 agentctl contributors.
"""Private native style observer with an unreachable package installer."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from agentctl.bootstrap import build, style, toolchain
from agentctl.bootstrap.pins import load
from agentctl.check.audit import event_arguments
from agentctl.check.style import StyleStep, run_step
from agentctl.hostfacts import current
from agentctl.process import run
from agentctl.result import Err, Ok

mode, folder, project, cache, ghc, harmless, nonce = sys.argv[1:]
folder, project = Path(folder), Path(project)
folder.mkdir(parents=True)
host = current(Path(cache))
home = folder / "home"
home.mkdir()
environment = dict(host.environment)
environment.update({"HOME": str(home), "USERPROFILE": str(home), **{
    f"XDG_{kind}_HOME": str(folder / kind.lower()) for kind in ("CACHE", "CONFIG", "DATA", "STATE")
}})
host = replace(host, home=home, cache=folder / "cache", environment=tuple(environment.items()))
selected = load()
assert isinstance(selected, Ok)
context = build.BuildContext(project, folder / "build", host, build.Toolchain(ghc, harmless))
assert isinstance(toolchain.record(context.tools, host.cache), Ok)
private = context.cabal_directory
index = private / "packages/hackage.haskell.org/01-index.tar"
index.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
index.touch()
(private / "agentctl-index-state").write_text("2026-10-31T00:00:00Z", encoding="utf-8")
if mode in {"warm", "leg-veto"}:
    source = style.paths(style.directory(Path(cache), selected.value), host.family)
    target_directory = style.directory(host.cache, selected.value)
    target_directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    target = style.paths(target_directory, host.family)
    for original, copied in ((source.fourmolu, target.fourmolu), (source.hlint, target.hlint)):
        try:
            copied.hardlink_to(original)
        except OSError:
            shutil.copy2(original, copied)
events = []
def observe(event, arguments):
    if event != "subprocess.Popen":
        return
    parsed = event_arguments(event, arguments)
    assert isinstance(parsed, Ok)
    argv = parsed.value.argv
    blocked = "install" in argv[1:] or (
        mode == "leg-veto" and Path(argv[0]).stem == "fourmolu" and "--version" not in argv[1:]
    )
    events.append({"nonce": nonce, "argv": list(argv), "blocked": blocked})
    if blocked:
        raise OSError("owned style boundary veto")
sys.addaudithook(observe)
control = run([sys.executable, "-c", "print('observer control')"], cwd=folder, env=environment)
assert isinstance(control, Ok) and control.value.code == 0
if mode == "leg-veto":
    result = run_step(StyleStep("fourmolu", host, project, selected))
    assert result != 0
elif mode == "warm":
    result = build.ensure_style_tools(context, selected.value)
    assert isinstance(result, Ok), "warm style ensure attempted installation"
elif mode == "cold":
    result = build.ensure_style_tools(context, selected.value)
    assert isinstance(result, Err) and "owned style boundary veto" in result.error.message
    assert not style.directory(context.host.cache, selected.value).exists()
    assert not tuple((context.host.cache / "tools").iterdir())
else:
    raise AssertionError("unknown observer mode")
print(json.dumps({"nonce": nonce, "events": events}))
